quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: The speaker doesn't name the object. Listen to what it does.
quests.explanation: Cutting paper is the job of scissors. A pen writes, a ruler measures and a crayon draws.
quests.textToSpeak: Can you pass me the thing we use to cut paper?

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: Think about what you put up when heavy rain starts.
quests.explanation: 'Pour' means heavy rain, and something you 'put up' over your head is an umbrella. A coat is worn, not put up.
quests.textToSpeak: It started to pour, so she put up the thing she'd been carrying in her bag.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: Listen to the shape, the color and who likes it.
quests.explanation: Long and yellow are the shape and color. Monkeys and bananas go together, so the banana is the match.
quests.textToSpeak: It's a long yellow fruit, and monkeys love it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: Where does the item go? Listen to the body part.
quests.explanation: 'Around his neck' points to a scarf. Gloves go on hands and a cap on the head.
quests.textToSpeak: In winter he always wraps the warm thing around his neck before going out.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: Catch the size, the color and the job of the vehicle.
quests.explanation: A big yellow vehicle for children going to school is a school bus. A taxi is a small car.
quests.textToSpeak: We stood in line to get on the big yellow vehicle that takes children to school.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: Listen to what the ground is covered in.
quests.explanation: Something white that you can build with is snow. The snowman is the picture that fits.
quests.textToSpeak: The ground was covered in white, and the kids were building a man out of it.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: Listen to what the woman does and where.
quests.explanation: Looking after sick people in a hospital describes a nurse. The other jobs are done elsewhere.
quests.textToSpeak: The woman who looks after sick people in the hospital was wearing a white uniform.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: Which thing makes drinks colder?
quests.explanation: Ice keeps things cold. Fire does the opposite, and an umbrella only gives shade.
quests.textToSpeak: We need something to keep our drinks cold at the beach.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: Listen to what people do inside the building.
quests.explanation: You borrow books for free from a library. A school also has books, but you don't borrow them there in the same way.
quests.textToSpeak: It's the building where you can borrow books for free.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: Listen to how he behaves and decide how he feels.
quests.explanation: Yawning and closing eyes show tiredness. The picture with the yawning face fits.
quests.textToSpeak: He kept yawning, and his eyes were closing during the film.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: Listen to the clothing and what he does.
quests.explanation: A tall white hat, cooking and shouting orders in a kitchen describe a chef.
quests.textToSpeak: A man in a tall white hat was cooking pasta and shouting orders at the staff.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: What weather has a loud noise and a flash of light?
quests.explanation: A bang and a flash in the sky are thunder and lightning, so a thunderstorm is the match.
quests.textToSpeak: We heard a loud bang in the sky, then saw a bright flash, and everybody ran inside.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: Why would someone say 'Smile!'?
quests.explanation: 'Smile!' is what you say before a photo. The item pointed at the family is a camera.
quests.textToSpeak: She took out a small square thing, pointed it at the family, and said, 'Smile!'

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: Listen to what is coming out of the oven.
quests.explanation: Loaves are bread, so the shop is a bakery. The other shops sell different food.
quests.textToSpeak: The shop on the corner smelled wonderful; they were taking fresh loaves out of the oven.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: Listen to where it is and how you use it.
quests.explanation: A light on the ceiling that you switch on is a bulb. A torch is carried, not fixed to the ceiling.
quests.textToSpeak: It's on the ceiling, and you switch it on when it gets dark.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: A doctor is giving instructions. What might he take with water?
quests.explanation: A small round item a doctor prescribes and you take with water is a tablet.
quests.textToSpeak: The doctor told him to take one small round white thing every morning with water.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: Listen to the shape, the colors and the place.
quests.explanation: A round black-and-white ball chased on the grass is a football.
quests.textToSpeak: The players were running after the round black-and-white ball on the grass.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: Listen to what he reads and when.
quests.explanation: Folded pages with the morning news are a newspaper. A novel isn't 'the news'.
quests.textToSpeak: He sat by the window, opened the folded pages, and started reading the morning news.

quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: What helps you read small letters?
quests.explanation: Glasses sit on your nose and help you see. Sunglasses are for bright light.
quests.textToSpeak: Grandpa puts two round glass things on his nose so he can read small letters.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: Where can you swim among waves?
quests.explanation: The sea has waves and big blue water. A river has no waves like that.
quests.textToSpeak: She jumped in and swam through the big blue place with waves.

quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: Listen to the body part and the action.
quests.explanation: A very long nose that sprays water describes an elephant.
quests.textToSpeak: The big animal with a very long nose sprayed water over its back.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: What do you put into a lock?
quests.explanation: You turn a key in a lock. Other small metal things don't open it.
quests.textToSpeak: He put the little metal thing into the lock and turned it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: Listen to where they were and what they could hear.
quests.explanation: Sand and waves mean a beach. A desert also has sand but no waves.
quests.textToSpeak: We lay on the sand, listened to the waves, and watched the sun go down.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: Listen to where it is worn.
quests.explanation: Something worn on the wrist to check the time is a watch. A wall clock stays on the wall.
quests.textToSpeak: You wear it on your wrist to check how late it is.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: What has four legs and can be stood on?
quests.explanation: A small wooden thing with four legs that you can stand on is a chair.
quests.textToSpeak: The little girl couldn't reach the shelf, so she stood on a small wooden thing with four legs.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: Listen to the shape and what holds it.
quests.explanation: A round prize worn on a ribbon is a medal. A trophy is a cup you hold.
quests.textToSpeak: At the end of the race, he was given a shiny round thing on a ribbon.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: Listen to the shape, color and how it's cooked.
quests.explanation: Long thin fried potato pieces are chips (French fries).
quests.textToSpeak: The waiter brought a plate of long thin yellow pieces of potato fried in oil.

quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: Think about which event has candles, balloons and singing.
quests.explanation: Candles, balloons and a special song are for a birthday.
quests.textToSpeak: There were candles, balloons, and everybody was singing to her.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: Listen to what the cars were doing.
quests.explanation: Cars standing still on a blocked road are a traffic jam.
quests.textToSpeak: The road was blocked, so the cars stood still for an hour.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: What kind of bag do shops give you?
quests.explanation: A paper bag with handles from a shop is a shopping bag.
quests.textToSpeak: The shop assistant put my shopping in a paper thing with handles.
